subject: Year-end QBR & Ops Readiness — week of Dec 18: wins, risks, asks
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Year-end QBR & Ops Readiness — week of Dec 18: wins, risks, asks

Hi all,

Quick weekly snapshot ahead of next week's QBR dry run. I've kept this tight — highlights, present risks, and specific asks. Please reply inline if you need a different cadence.

Wins
- Dedicated rollout for Tier-1 customers completed in APAC region (8 GPU pools online); early latency telemetry matches SLA targets.
- Cost experiment (dynamic prefix caching) reduced token spend on customer inference by ~12% on avg for Q4 workloads.
- Security intake: SOC2 evidence collection is 85% complete; audit window on track for Jan.

Current risks / near-term blockers
- Two critical regressions in v2.4 runtime affecting long-sequence attention for RLHF-style prompts — mitigation PR queued but needs extended validation (ETA: 48–72h).
- One enterprise renewal with Acme (HS-14287) flagged for deeper pricing discussion; legal wants a clarified data-retention clause.
- QBR runbook needs a final operations run-through; several owners still need to confirm talking points.

Asks (action items)
- Jonas: prioritize the runtime regression validation window. If tests fail, please open an incident and loop infra immediately. (Owner: jonas)
- Laura: can you confirm the executive-facing slide for cost/unit economics? Need sign-off by Tue 12/21 COB.
- Marissa: please coordinate the Acme redline discussion with Sales + Legal; copy the procurement thread.
- Leadership distro: review attached QBR_runbook_v3.pdf and add any gaps in the shared Drive link by EOD Monday.

Operational notes
- Added a short appendix (tab 3) in okrs-progress.csv showing per-initiative delta vs. Q3 baseline.
- Customer escalation timeline attached for reference (customer context removed where sensitive).

I'll run a 30-min ops dry run on Wed 12/21 at 10:00 PT; calendar invite incoming.

Thanks — short and actionable.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.inference

Attachments: QBR_runbook_v3.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB), okrs-progress.csv (csv), customer-escalation-timeline.xlsx (xlsx)

Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Year-end QBR & Ops Readiness — week of Dec 18: wins, risks, asks

Got it. Quick updates:
- Regression PR (runtime/v2.4) is green on unit tests; running long-seq perf sweep now. If perf delta > 5% I'll attach logs and request a hotfix pipeline.
- Can take the incident owner role if we need to break glass — will stand by during the validation window.

One ask: Mina, please add the incident-contact escalation matrix to the QBR runbook (page 5). I had a request from DevRel this morning asking who to page on weekends.

Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:53:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Year-end QBR & Ops Readiness — week of Dec 18: wins, risks, asks

Thanks Mina — this is helpful. A few decisions and clarifications:

Decisions
- Approve inclusion of the cost experiment numbers in the exec slide (as long as we add a short methodology note). I'll sign the slide deck by Tue COB.
- We'll move the Acme renewal conversation into a dedicated thread with Sales + Legal — no exec call needed unless we hit a critical approval slip.

Clarifications / asks
- Marissa: please drop the Acme redlines (latest PDF) into the procurement folder and ping legal with the specific retention language required.
- Ops run-through: keep it to 30 minutes and focus on the two scenarios: live-incident (regression) and capacity spike (black-friday-like).

On Monday I'll also attach an executive summary (one pager) that the board wants for the QBR packet — please aim to keep the Ops section to 3 bullets + link to appendix.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Cc: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Year-end QBR & Ops Readiness — week of Dec 18: wins, risks, asks

Quick follow-up after legal sync and procurement check:
- Acme: legal requested the data-retention clause be clarified to specify 90 days ephemeral cache retention and 2-year archival for audit logs; Sales is prepared to offer a term concession (3% credit) if they sign by 1/10. I uploaded the redline to the procurement folder and linked it in the HubSpot deal record (HS-14287).
- Incident playbook: I added Jonas' escalation matrix to QBR_runbook_v3 (tab "Contacts") and flagged two entries for exec attention (on-call rotation exceptions).

Next steps
- Mina: if runtime regression validation completes cleanly, please send a short confirmation note to the exec distro with the final telemetry numbers so we can finalize the incident scenario slide.
- Laura: once the one-pager is attached, I'll pull the vendor concession into the renewal plan for Acme.

Thanks team — see you Wed for the ops dry run.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
